$comment: Run O1 lane K1, new series batch 3 (K1-new-series): data for Violet Evergarden (tier C), built from pinned Wikipedia revisions (main article, the 2020 film and the 2019 side story film), Wikidata Q22101190 (light novels), Q57390937 (TV anime), Q106434135 (film) and Q73896191 (side story film), the official TV anime site tv.violet-evergarden.jp (music and staff pages), and Anime News Network (encyclopedia ids 19665 and 21959, news item on the 2020 film). Arcs follow the release order of the anime: the 13 episode TV series, the extra episode (OVA), the side story film and the 2020 film. Wikidata counts three light novel volumes and Wikipedia four (it adds the side story volume), so the volume count is not stated. The TV start date is January 11, 2018 on Wikipedia and Wikidata, while Anime News Network gives January 10 for the late night slot. Characters carry the arc where they first matter; levels are editorial judgments and the later arc was chosen when unsure. The fate of Gilbert is kept in facts tagged at the last arc.

characters.name: Violet Evergarden
characters.name_native: ヴァイオレット・エヴァーガーデン

characters.name: Claudia Hodgins
characters.name_native: クラウディア・ホッジンズ

characters.name_native: カトレア・ボードレール

characters.name: Benedict Blue
